Sublime themes

Jun 23, 2024

Editor

Alpen - the light color scheme.

Install using Package Control

  • Enter Package Control: Install Package
  • Search for Alpen Color Scheme
  • Activating the Alpen Color Scheme
  • Preferences > Color Scheme > select > Alpen

Alpen download from the GitHub.

Lotus - the dark color scheme.

Install using Package Control

  • Enter Package Control: Install Package
  • Search for Lotus Color Scheme
  • Activating the Lotus Color Scheme
  • Preferences > Color Scheme > select > Lotus

Lotus download from the GitHub.
